b2_not_derived.address_terms_for_npcs: Not derivable. The NPC speakers are not in charData.csv, so there is no name form to search her lines for. Only the eight named cast and the protagonist 一悟 have alias forms.
b2_not_derived.expression_label_uncertainty: Expression triggers inherit the C4 hypothesis: a label on a line is the merged visual/context guess, not ground truth.
rhetorical_mechanisms_deferred_to_b3: This list is the B2 residue, kept for provenance. B3 addressed it: see the `mechanisms` section. The B2 residue named deflects a topic, changes the subject, teases, jokes, stalls with repetition, or answers a question with a question - none of these carries an authored stage direction.
b2_not_derived.room_definition: The room is every other speaker in her scenes, named cast and NPCs together; the plan leaves this open.
b2_not_derived.tokenizer: The surface battery splits on punctuation (a class-based tokenizer), not morphology, so particles are matched by string suffix against a fixed list and the n-grams are character n-grams.
b2_not_derived.trigger_causality: Every trigger table is co-occurrence over her lines, not cause. The authored direction is a staging choice on the line; it does not say why.

emotional_pressures.note: Authored @emotion overlay types and C4 expression labels are distinct sets; the first is the author's, the second a hypothesis.

mechanisms.class_note: Every mechanism is classed `hers`: the matchers in tools/koikano/b3/maria.py were written from her own lines, and each recurs across her scenes. Nothing was classed `author` or `moment`. The `distinctive` flag compares her rate with the other heroines in her scenes; the B4 gate re-tested it on the holdout. Tiers follow one count rule (see tier_rule): firm 50 lines or more, thin 10 to 49, weak under 10 or not distinctive.
mechanisms.control_definition: The other named heroines' spoken lines in her scenes (the room minus the protagonist 一悟 and minus her). control_rate is hits over that set; it is the per-bible house-style baseline. The B4 gate used a held-out, same-scene contrast with six heroines and is the authority for `distinctive`.
mechanisms.cross_reference: These are the moves that carry no `@emotion` / `@face` / `@action`. The surface rules they lean on (the polite です / ます register, the ellipsis, the ？ / ！ marks) are measured separately in `speech_guide` and in `voice.surface`; this section adds the move, not the mark.

mechanisms.definition: Puts the listener's name and 様 (お嬢様, 宮国様, 真優様, 千奈様, アリス様) or 先生 at the start or end of the line.
mechanisms.method: regex: one of お嬢様 / 宮国様 / 真優様 / 千奈様 / アリス様 / 小野坂様 / 榎本先生 / ご主人様 / 奥様 within the first 10 or the last 12 characters.
mechanisms.name: Frames the turn with the listener's title
mechanisms.note: How she addresses people. 宮国様 is 一悟 (the record gives him the family name; she does not say 一悟).

mechanisms.definition: Opens or closes a turn with a set maid phrase: 失礼いたします, かしこまりました, させていただく, お待ちしております.
mechanisms.method: regex: 失礼いたし / かしこまり / 承知 / させていただ / お待ちしており / 恐縮 / 僭越 / お手伝い / ご案内いたし / お届け / お持ちし.
mechanisms.name: Uses fixed service formulas
mechanisms.note: Formulas, so repetition is the point. Exact repeats such as 「失礼いたします」 appear 4 times.

mechanisms.definition: Offers to take the task, protect, support or arrange: お支えいたします, お守りします, お任せください, いたしましょうか.
mechanisms.method: regex: いたしましょうか / いたしますわ / いたしますね / お支え / お守り / お任せ / お力になり / させてくださ / ご用意いたし / 私がいたし.
mechanisms.name: Offers to do or carry it
mechanisms.note: The service stance as a move. A lower bound: offers phrased another way are not caught.

mechanisms.definition: Ends a clause in the ladylike register: ですわ, ますわ, でしたわ, ですわね.
mechanisms.method: regex: です / ます / ません / でした / ました / ですの / たい / ない / ある / いる followed by わ and no further kana.
mechanisms.name: Closes the clause with わ
mechanisms.note: A surface habit, counted here because it is the commonest ending she has. ですわ alone ends 83 lines.

mechanisms.definition: Points back to a stated plan with ではないですか, 仰っていた, でしたよね.
mechanisms.method: regex: 仰っていた / おっしゃっていた anywhere, or 先日 / 先ほど / 昨日 / さっき followed in the same sentence by ではないですか / ではありませんか / でしたよね / ましたよね.

mechanisms.note: How she corrects without contradicting: she cites the person's own words.

mechanisms.name: Directs with くださいませ / てください

mechanisms.definition: Praises the listener or a third party: さすが, 素敵, 素晴らしい, 立派, 頼もしい.

mechanisms.definition: Apologises or calls herself at fault: 申し訳ありません, 失態, メイド失格, 至らず.
mechanisms.method: regex: 申し訳 / 失態 / 失格 / 不手際 / ご無礼 / お詫び / 至らな.

mechanisms.note: Thin by count; kept because it is the one place she names her own failing.

mechanisms.definition: Mock-complains or needles in a soft register: いけず, つれない, おとぼけ.
mechanisms.method: regex: いけず / つれない / おとぼけ / 意地悪 / いじわる / お人が悪い / 悪戯 / いたずら / からかい.
mechanisms.name: Teases gently
mechanisms.note: A lower bound: her teasing often has no marker word.

mechanisms.note: The mechanisms are the builder's reading of her speech across her scenes, not the author's: the definitions and the classing are interpretive, the line counts and the receipts are mechanical. A regex count is a lower bound where the move is defined by reading. Receipts are the first matching lines in scene order. `lines_H` / `lines_non_H` split the count by the @Hシーン開始 register.

mechanisms.tier_rule: one rule for every entry, from the count n of her lines (or occurrences where the receipt counts occurrences) behind the entry's headline claim: firm = n of 50 or more and not marked non-distinctive; thin = n of 10 to 49; weak = n under 10, an absence ('she does not do X', n is 0), a caveat with no count, or distinctive false

provenance.b3_reading: B3 added the `mechanisms` section: the recurring rhetorical moves that carry no authored stage direction. The definitions, the class and the tier are the builder's reading; the line counts come from the fixed matchers named per mechanism, and the receipts are real record ids. No API call was made.
corrections: B1 read the alias table from charData.csv, which omits the protagonist 一悟; B2 adds him for the address-term derivation in this bible only.

The B2 residue named 'deflects a topic, changes the subject, teases, jokes, stalls with repetition, or answers a question with a question'; those are covered by `doubles_a_key_word`, `closes_a_turn_with_a_short_question`, `names_a_blow_with_a_loanword` and `plays_a_role_with_stock_catchphrases`.
